items.text: Approve the terms and conditions and authorize the General Manager to execute a no-fee, month-to-month revocable license to the City of Sunnyvale to use approximately 17 acres of SFPUC land, consisting of portions of SFPUC Parcel Nos. 144, 145A, 146, 148, 152, 154B, 156A, 159, and 165, and the entirety of SFPUC Parcel Nos. 145, 149, 150, 151, 153, 154A, 155, 161, 162, and 164 in Sunnyvale, California for (i) operating, maintaining, managing and repairing an existing public recreational pedestrian and bicycle path; (ii) maintaining existing landscaping in accordance with the SFPUC Vegetation Management Policy; (iii) maintaining and repairing a portion of an existing pedestrian and bicycle ramp; (iv) maintaining certain permitted encroachments consisting of light poles, picnic tables, barbecues, and shade structures; (v) maintaining and repairing existing public street crossings; (vi) installing new educational signage regarding the SFPUC water system; (vii) operating, maintaining, and repairing the existing irrigation systems; and (viii) maintaining the existing Manzano Way park area improvements consisting of picnic tables, parkour structures, and a horseshoe pit

items.title: Public Hearing to consider and possible action to adopt revised miscellaneous fees for the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Water Enterprise
items.text: Public Hearing to consider and possible action to adopt revised miscellaneous fees for the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Water Enterprise related to temporary water service through hydrants (Schedule W-41B) and backflow prevention (Schedule W-45). If approved, the proposed fees will become effective on July 1, 2026, and will remain effective until revised by a future Commission action. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Public Hearing to consider and possible action to adopt three new Wastewater Enterprise Regulatory Compliance fees
items.text: Public Hearing to consider and possible action to adopt three new Wastewater Enterprise Regulatory Compliance fees (Schedule W-46) that support the enforcement of the rules and regulations that pertain to the Stormwater Management Ordinance. If approved, the new Stormwater Management Ordinance Miscellaneous Fees will become effective on or after July 1, 2026, and will remain in effect until revised by a future Commission action. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Chapter 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Public Hearing to consider and possible action to adopt new fees for the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Power Enterprise
items.text: Public Hearing to consider and possible action to adopt new fees for the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Power Enterprise related to (1) streetlighting, (2) service connections, (3) rules and regulations variance requests, (4) municipal pole use, (5) generator interconnections, and (6) gas service requests. If approved, the proposed fees will become effective on or after July 1, 2026, and will remain effective until revised by a future Commission action. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action
